title: Transport & vehicle enquiries
description: Request a transfer, sightseeing vehicle or information about self-drive options in Kashmir, Ladakh and Jammu.

copy.original: Discuss airport transfers, a private sightseeing vehicle, or a self-drive enquiry. Vehicle availability and supplier terms need confirmation.
copy.value: Discuss airport transfers, a private sightseeing vehicle, or a self-drive enquiry. Vehicle availability and supplier terms need confirmation.

copy.original: Self-drive is an enquiry option only. We do not advertise an owned fleet or confirmed rental rates. Supplier availability, licence eligibility, permitted areas and vehicle documents must be checked first.
